subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexaaquatitanium(III)（[Ti(H₂O)₆]³⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Tetrahedral
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Ti (group 4) 4 e; 6 × H₂O (L) 12 e; the 3+ charge removes 3 e: 13 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 3+ charge, so the metal is Ti(III), d¹; d¹ + 12 e from the ligands = 13 e. Coordination complexes of early metals are often far below 18 electrons.
